hero.badge: Full-stack starter with admin console and workspace
hero.subtitle: Sign-in, roles and permissions, auditing and notifications come wired end to end. Built on Angular and .NET 10 — trim what you do not need and ship from day one.
hero.note: Open source · Self-hosted · Front end and back end included

features.title: The back office essentials are already wired
features.subtitle: You write the business logic. Sign-in, permissions and auditing come with a complete front end, back end and tests.
features.authDesc: Password and authenticator-app sign-in with lockout, recovery codes and re-authentication sharing one policy.
features.rbacDesc: Permissions grouped by module; menus and buttons follow what each role is allowed to do.
features.tenantsDesc: Tenants resolved by domain or chosen at sign-in, with data isolated per tenant.
features.auditDesc: Who did what and when — every write is recorded, filterable and exportable.
features.notificationsDesc: Notifications pushed over SignalR, scaled across instances, with history after reconnecting.
features.openAppsDesc: Issue client credentials to other systems through a standard OpenID Connect server.
features.i18nDesc: English and Chinese switch at runtime; light and dark themes follow the system without flicker.
features.themeDesc: Semantic color tokens with light and dark modes; rebrand by changing a few variables.
